about: Every Round 2 attempt that got past the starter gate (the run timer ran >= ~5 min) on the runner's 2026-11 streams, with the run-timer minute where it ended. Read off the committed starters/*.jsonl|md tables (outcome ACCEPTED rows, attempt_timer_* / shown_s / notes fields) and the 2026-11-12 stream splits (st-splits-B.jsonl, stream-2026-11-12-main97.md). External claims; times are +-0.5 min (keyframe sampling). 2026-11-14 (YouTube, added 2026-11-17) rows are from stream-2026-11-14-main97.md. 2026-11-10 (YouTube) and 2026-11-12 (Twitch) are one stream and are counted once (the Twitch rows plus the deep run). 2026-11-05 is left out: its ACCEPTED rows are 'box static' lower bounds (confidence low). Rows that began before the video (carry-over) and rows still running at a video's end are kind 'censored' and are not in the death counts. kind: death = the run ended in a reset or a whiteout the runner did not salvage (the evidence does not tell deaths from pace resets apart; both are 'the model lost the attempt'); pace = a deliberate reset at the E4 door (S12: 2:39:37 with 60/60); finish = reached the credits.
